items.html: And do not wonder at this, for they are very close to the Land of Israel, as it is stated in the Midrash and in the Jerusalem Talmud: there was an incident concerning a certain man who was plowing with his cow, and it fled from before him, and he ran after it until they reached Babylon before nightfall. If so, it is not far-fetched that his body was from the Land of Israel and his buttocks from Babylon — these being the two upper joints adjacent to the body. And the remaining four lower joints of his two legs were from the other lands outside the Land.
